steps.title: Standardize labels & parse values
steps.description: Trimmed whitespace, unified casing and synonyms ('Gas' → 'Gasoline', 'Chevy' → 'Chevrolet', '4x4' → '4WD') and parsed currency/unit strings ('$18,450', '45,000 mi', '2.0L') into numbers.

steps.title: Drop rows missing price or make/model
steps.description: A listing without a price cannot be used for supervised learning; make and model are required identifiers.

steps.title: Remove duplicate listings
steps.description: Removed re-posted listings (same listing id) and rows that are identical after normalisation.

steps.title: Drop invalid model years
steps.description: Model year must be between 1990 and 2027 (typos such as 1900 or 2099 are removed).

steps.title: Nullify impossible values
steps.description: Negative or absurd mileage (> 600,000 mi), engine sizes outside 0–8.5 L and owner counts outside 1–10 are set to missing and imputed later.

steps.title: Remove implausible prices
steps.description: Prices below $500 or above $500,000 are placeholders or typos (e.g. $1, $999,999).

steps.title: Remove statistical price outliers
steps.description: Modified z-score of log(price) within comparable vehicles (same make & model, 3-year age band); |z| > 5 is flagged.

selection.description: Lowest mean RMSE (USD) across 5-fold cross-validation on the training split; the test split is only used for the final report.
